name: 7+3 + Midostaurin (FLT3-mutated AML induction)

biomarkers.FLT3: mutated (internal tandem duplication [ITD] or tyrosine kinase domain [TKD])
biomarkers.note: Midostaurin is added to standard 7+3 for AML with a FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutation. FLT3 mutation testing is part of the diagnostic molecular workup. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14 (regimen restricted to FLT3-ITD or TKD).

lineOfTherapy: first-line induction for newly diagnosed, intensive-induction-eligible AML with a FLT3-ITD or TKD mutation

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14 (Standard 7+3 + midostaurin, FLT3-ITD or TKD)

drugs.name: CYTARabine
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14. Cytarabine 100 or 200 mg/m2 by continuous infusion for 7 days; 100 mg/m2/day used here as the lower stated value, 200 mg/m2/day is the alternative stated value. Confirm institutional standard.

drugs.name: DAUNOrubicin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14. Daunorubicin 60 mg/m2 IV on days 1 to 3. Alternative anthracycline is idarubicin 12 mg/m2 (either/or, not additive). Cumulative-lifetime cap values (450/550 mg/m2) are the conventional doxorubicin-equivalent anthracycline safety thresholds, not printed for daunorubicin in this source; verify institutional conversion before enforcing.

drugs.name: IDArubicin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14. Idarubicin 12 mg/m2 IV on days 1 to 3, as an alternative (either/or) to daunorubicin; only one anthracycline is given per cycle. Cumulative-lifetime cap values (450/550 mg/m2) are conventional doxorubicin-equivalent thresholds, not printed for idarubicin in this source; verify institutional conversion before enforcing.

drugs.name: Midostaurin

provenance.locator: AML-E 1 of 14 (Standard 7+3 + midostaurin regimen line: oral midostaurin 50 mg every 12 hours, days 8 to 21)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14. Midostaurin 50 mg PO every 12 hours (twice daily) on days 8 to 21, added to the 7+3 backbone. FLT3 inhibitor; take with food. dosePerUnit 50 mg is the single-administration dose given twice daily.

supportiveCare: High emetic risk regimen (anthracycline plus cytarabine): antiemetic prophylaxis per NCCN Antiemesis high-emetic-risk tier.
AML induction is conventionally high febrile-neutropenia risk: prophylactic support per NCCN Hematopoietic Growth Factors high-risk tier.
Patients with high blast counts are at risk for tumor lysis and leukostasis: TLS prophylaxis (hydration, allopurinol or uric-acid-lowering agent) and cytoreduction as indicated.

Midostaurin (an FLT3 inhibitor) can prolong the QT interval: baseline and on-treatment ECG/QTc and electrolyte monitoring are advised per drug labeling; review concurrent QT-prolonging drugs and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.

monitoring: CBC before induction and daily during induction (marrow aplasia expected)
cardiac assessment (anthracycline): baseline LVEF and as clinically indicated
ECG/QTc and electrolytes for midostaurin (QT prolongation risk)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 non-hematologic toxicity or QT prolongation
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt or reduce midostaurin per prescribing information for significant toxicity, including QT prolongation; obtain clinical review.

guideline.locator: AML-E 1 of 14 (Principles of Systemic Therapy for AML, Intensive Induction Eligible: Standard 7+3 [daunorubicin or idarubicin] + midostaurin [FLT3-ITD or TKD]): cytarabine 100 or 200 mg/m2 continuous infusion x 7 days, daunorubicin 60 mg/m2 or idarubicin 12 mg/m2 x 3 days, oral midostaurin 50 mg every 12 hours days 8 to 21; FLT3 workup on AML-1

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for FLT3-mutated (ITD or TKD) AML: the standard 7+3 induction backbone plus midostaurin. Complements the existing aml-7-plus-3-induction protocol by adding the FLT3-inhibitor layer; the 7+3 backbone doses match that protocol. All four drug doses are grounded to a single locator, Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Acute Myeloid Leukemia v5.2026, AML-E 1 of 14: cytarabine 100 or 200 mg/m2 continuous infusion for 7 days, daunorubicin 60 mg/m2 or idarubicin 12 mg/m2 for 3 days, and oral midostaurin 50 mg every 12 hours on days 8 to 21. daunorubicin and idarubicin are alternative anthracyclines (either/or, only one per cycle). histology is VERIFY (subtype beyond AML not established on the dosing page); cycleLengthDays and cycles are VERIFY because the induction page does not print a fixed cycle length or cycle count. QTc monitoring is added for midostaurin per drug-class safety. Core textbook cross-reference is pending; grounding is guideline-layer only. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
